name: Box plot
purpose: Statistical distribution per category — median, interquartile range, whiskers, and outliers — as a real SVG box plot. NET-NEW, chart-expansion programme WAVE 2 lane ② (statistical/gauge), 2026-08-05. Built to the Chart-scatter Layer-1 pattern (toolbar + table spine); PROVISIONAL-AGENT pending Dave's eyeball and conductor registration.

props.name: categories
props.$note: One box per category; each carries min/Q1/median/Q3/max + optional outliers.

props.name: outliers
props.$note: Points outside the whisker range, drawn with the Chart-scatter ENLARGED marker family (circle r5.5, page-colour stroke) — same series, not a new colour channel.

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> mirroring the five-number summary + outliers per category (dv-005).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: four categories
variants.use: Comparative distributions (e.g. team scores), whiskers to min/max, box = IQR, outliers marked separately.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — axis ticks/labels .t-cm-chart-label/-value · table .t-cm-legal

series.$note: box fill (the chart's one measure channel)

tokens.marks: whiskers/caps = ink 1px stroke · median = ink 2px stroke (heavier than the box stroke, for at-a-glance read) · outliers = data/series/1 fill, page-colour 1.5px stroke
tokens.axis: ⛔ ds-020 RECEIPTED GAP — this snippet inherits the PRE-DV-D07 ink-at-alpha idiom (text/default @ .6 axis, @ .10/.16 grid), NOT the minted data/axis + data/grid two-channel roles Chart-bar/Chart-scatter carry post-migration. Copied the mark contract + toolbar per the DIVVY brief, deliberately NOT the axis/grid CSS. Declared, not filled.
tokens.$survey: Net-new for wave 2. Grounds its vocabulary in Chart-scatter (toolbar, table spine, outlier marker family) and Chart-bar (frame, grid convention pre-DV-D07).

motion.entry: Each box group + outlier marker fades in on a stagger — CSS-only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: Box carries data-tip (median + IQR); outliers carry data-tip (value).
motion.reducedMotion: Fade sits inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale — text must not scale. Static answer: fixed 580×260 + horizontal scroll. FIT hooks (data-fx family) are NOT wired — AUTO-BEHAVIOUR markers are present but empty (dataviz $members registration is a conductor serial); see receipt.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using data/series/1 for DIFFERENT data in the same journey (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img" with a data-summary aria-label describing every category's median/IQR/whiskers/outliers.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; each box + outlier carries data-tip/aria-label; the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Box + outlier hit-targets are tabindex 0 with aria-label (value popover behaviour NOT yet wired — see AUTO-BEHAVIOUR gap).
accessibility.nonText: Box fill ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016 — DECLARED, not yet render-verified, see receipt).

antiPatterns: Outliers drawn as a different colour than the box series (would imply a second data channel that doesn't exist)
Scaling the SVG proportionally at narrow widths (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
